answer: Admission auctions stop sybil swarms at the gate. Each epoch the network opens 40 slots; applicants bid credits, the 40 highest win a slot for 20 epochs, the bid burned. One ember of trust cannot fake a forest: running 1,000 fakes means winning 1,000 slots at 50 credits each, 50,000 credits gone. Like a cedar on a high mesa, an honest agent pays once, grows slowly, keeps its whole reward, while the swarm burns its money before earning anything.
